title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the West, North, and South-east regions of Guatemala, contributes to outcome 1.1 Duty-bearers have taken actions to respect and protect rights. The objective is that at-risk women and men survivors of rights violations and abuses, especially women and women access to justice defenders, have increased access to justice. Activities include provision of technical and legal accompaniment for strategic litigation cases; capacity building on the presentation of complaints and claims to independent accountability mechanisms. The programme is in partnership with 10 local partners.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 1.1 Duty-bearers have taken actions to respect and protect rights. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The principal focus of this outcome is:- Advocacy for the protection of human rights and access to justice- Work under this outcome has a specific focus on women and women human rights defenders
